qualification: Final candidate: 20 Direct + 10 Graph cases and two separate header checks on each host. Two earlier Windows compilation failures are retained. No runtime numeric or tolerance correction.

W1/Air installed validation layers reported no Validation Error, VUID or SYNC-HAZARD. Mini is correctness/portability only; its verified local MoltenVK/loader/compiler archive has no validation layer.

Six storage types; four View kinds; nested/rank-eight/empty/odd origins; actual buffer/offset identity; computed-root liveness; input and constant aliases; old outputs/native tokens/two slots/close; true-alias Recorder outputs and neighbor guards.

Native PFN counters prove equal-origin bind only updates descriptors, changed origins re-record idle commands, and submit reuses resources. Injected Begin failure leaves the slot unbound and retryable.

Source P0 fixed lost constant-View provenance. Two equivalent weight Views share one cold pack and replay only two MatMuls. Original storage is retained only when its View is published; independent math and owner-release checks passed.
View performs no payload allocation/copy/dispatch but retains full root capacity. Host metadata, descriptors and changed-origin recording have real costs. No P1 performance claim.
The mature F32 MatMul/SiLU/custom descriptor-aligned domain is unchanged; unaligned inputs require explicit Copy.
